connections.notes: Room 9 (Northern Corridor) is directly adjacent to 7 along the east-west corridor. There is a clear open passage connecting them with no door visible between the two labels.
J2 (Western Corridor Fork) sits at the western end of the corridor containing 7. The corridor runs openly from 7 westward to J2 with no intervening walls or doors.
Room 13 (The Riven Hall) is north of 7. There appears to be a passage or opening connecting the corridor at 7 northward into room 13.

not_connected.reason: Room 12 (Hanging South Alcove) is separated from 7 by walls and intervening spaces. No direct passage visible between them.
Room 3C (Arched Stairwell Junction) is located further west/south from 7 with walls between them. No direct connection visible.
Room 4 (Great Northern Hall) is south/southeast of 7, separated by walls. No direct passage or door connects them.
Room 4A (Great Bronze Doors) is east of 9, not directly adjacent to 7. Separated by room 9 and walls.
J3 (Trapped Fork) is located further west beyond J2. No direct passage from 7 to J3 without passing through J2.
R1 (North-West River Crossing) is north of the corridor area but separated from 7 by walls and the river. No direct river crossing connection at location 7.
R2 (North River Crossing) is in the river area to the north, separated from 7 by walls and intervening rooms.
R3 (North River Passage) is far to the northeast, well separated from 7 with no direct connection.
R4 (East River Crossing) is far to the east, separated by multiple rooms and walls from 7.
R5 (River exit at cliff) is at the far south of the map, nowhere near 7.
